This small fruit plot is mine, and it is very small, so I will not spend cash on chemical fertilizer for it. I will carry manure and compost from home and put it around the trees, because that is what I have and I have seen it help. I will keep the local planting material I already trust, weed it by hand, and I will not hire people for such a small place. If the rain comes as usual, I will leave it without irrigation.
